summary: XGrammar now receives the union of model-config EOS IDs, tokenizer.eos_token_id, and tokenizer.additional_stop_token_ids, matching server-side token finish detection.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: tokenizer EOS and additional stop IDs were absent from the XGrammar constructor arguments. Raw output: raw/failing_before.log
Passing-after focused factory suite: 35 tests and 17 subtests passed, including mismatch, deduplication, and empty-input boundaries. Raw output: raw/passing_after.log

Actual XGrammar bitmask after regex acceptance: tokenizer EOS was disallowed with model-only stops and allowed with the union; model EOS remained allowed. Raw output: raw/xgrammar_mask_reproduction.log
Repository formatting, lint, safety, and registered-test checks for changed source and test files. Raw output: raw/pre_commit.log

gpu_evidence: The defect is CPU-side stop-token plumbing and XGrammar mask construction. The reported private Qwen3.5-MoE weights and B200 environment were unavailable; no smaller fixture was represented as a full-model reproduction.
remaining_limitations: No end-to-end HTTP serving run with the reported private Qwen3.5-MoE checkpoint or NVIDIA B200 hardware.
Per-request sampling_params.stop_token_ids still do not reach the grammar matcher and are outside this narrow fix.
